prompt:
Image 1 is the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge of a room. Edit it into the same view of the same room at this time of day: Day. Keep the camera position, framing, lens, walls, doors, windows, furniture, materials and colours exactly as in Image 1; change only the light. Outside every window and doorway, show what that place looks like at Day, with the sky, light and lit windows of that time, never the daylight scene of Image 1 darkened. Inside, light the room as the description says it is lit at that time, with only the lamps it names turned on. The place stays completely empty of people: no person, figure, silhouette or reflection of a person anywhere. Location: SU YAQING'S DINING AREA. Elegant dining nook in the same luxury apartment. A round white marble table holds a vase of daisies and a wine bottle, with upholstered dining chairs around it. A chair beside it stands by a tall window. Soft daylight comes through the window from the side, and a modern brass pendant lamp hangs above the table.

Avoid: people or silhouettes, a darkened copy of Image 1's daylight, readable text, labels, signs with letters or numbers, logos, watermark.
